svg.title: Conceptual CEPC token-based grid data transfer model
svg.desc: Applications sit outside the infrastructure boundary and submit requests to FTS within it. FTS controls transfers at storage endpoints. IAM issues scoped tokens to applications; endpoints verify token trust and enforce access. Payload moves directly between illustrative worldwide storage sites, not through FTS or IAM.

g.text: Processing, analysis and replicas across sites
TPC-capable storage endpoints · verify tokens and enforce access
Direct data movement across the WAN · third-party copy (TPC)
